Sir / Madam,

Subject: Notice under section 143(2) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 for the Assessment Year 2025-26 - Selection of case for limited scrutiny - Reg.

1. Your return of income for the Assessment Year 2025-26 (acknowledgement number 482910376250725001) declaring total income of Rs 14,86,320/- has been selected for scrutiny under the National Faceless Assessment Scheme, 2021 (the "Scheme") for the purpose of verifying the issue mentioned in paragraph 2 below.

2. Reasons for selection - limited scrutiny: The case has been selected for LIMITED SCRUTINY on the following issue(s):

(i) Cash deposits during the year: Information available with the department shows that cash deposits aggregating to Rs 38,40,000/- (Rupees Thirty-Eight Lakh Forty Thousand only) were made in your bank accounts during the Financial Year 2024-25, which appear to be not commensurate with the income declared and the cash sales and receipts disclosed in the return.

(ii) Mismatch between the turnover in the return and the turnover in the GST returns, to the extent relevant to issue (i).

The scrutiny shall be limited to the aforesaid issue(s). However, the assessing officer may, with the prior approval of the competent authority, convert the case into a complete scrutiny case in accordance with the procedure prescribed by the Central Board of Direct Taxes.

3. You are hereby required to attend the proceedings and to produce, or cause to be produced, any evidence on which you may rely in support of the return of income, through the e-proceedings facility on the e-filing portal (www.incometax.gov.in) of the Income Tax Department in the following manner:

Response to be filed by: 4 November 2026 (fifteen (15) days from the date of this notice), up to 11:59 p.m.
Mode: Online, through the "e-Proceedings" tab on your e-filing account. No physical appearance is required unless specifically called for.

4. You are requested to furnish, on or before the date mentioned in paragraph 3, the following details and documents in respect of the cash deposits of Rs 38,40,000/-:

(a) Bank-wise and account-wise details of all cash deposits made during the Financial Year 2024-25 along with date-wise bank statements for all your bank accounts, including current and savings accounts.
(b) The source of each cash deposit, supported by sale invoices, cash book, ledger accounts of customers, and daily cash sale summaries.
(c) A reconciliation of the cash deposits with the cash sales disclosed in the books of account, and the cash balance as on 1 April 2024 and 31 March 2025.
(d) Copies of the audited financial statements and tax audit report in Form 3CB-3CD for the Assessment Year 2025-26, if applicable, and details of cash-in-hand maintained.
(e) A reconciliation of the turnover declared in the GST returns (GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B) for FY 2024-25 with the gross receipts shown in the profit and loss account.
(f) Any other documents or evidence in support of your claim.

5. Please note that if you fail to comply with the terms of this notice, or fail to appear or file a response, the assessing officer shall be at liberty to complete the assessment to the best of his judgment under section 144 of the Act, based on the material available on record, and to initiate penalty proceedings under section 271(1)(b) of the Act, which provides for a penalty of Rs 10,000/- for each failure to comply with a notice issued under section 142(1) or section 143(2), apart from the other consequences.

6. In case the response cannot be filed on the due date, you may request an adjournment through the e-proceedings tab, giving valid reasons, before the due date mentioned in paragraph 3. Adjournments shall be granted at the discretion of the assessing officer.

7. Under the Scheme, all communications shall be made electronically, and no personal contact with any official of the assessment unit shall be made. You may, however, seek a video conference through video conferencing facility (VC) at the National Faceless Assessment Centre, if you so desire, by making a request in the manner provided in the Scheme.

8. Please ensure that the contact details (e-mail ID and mobile number) on your e-filing account are updated, as all intimations shall be sent to the registered e-mail ID and mobile number. A copy of this notice has been uploaded on your e-filing account under "Pending Actions - e-Proceedings", and shall be deemed to be served on the date of such upload.

9. If you have authorised a Chartered Accountant, advocate or other authorised representative, you may add him as representative on the e-filing portal for this proceeding in accordance with section 288 of the Income-tax Act, 1961.

10. This notice is issued without prejudice to the powers of the department under any other provision of the Income-tax Act, 1961, including section 148 and section 148A.

Yours faithfully,

(Digitally signed)
Assessment Unit
National Faceless Assessment Centre
Income Tax Department, Delhi

On behalf of: Assessing Officer, ITO (Ward 1(2)(4)), Ahmedabad

Nodal contact: For portal-related queries, use the "Help" section and the grievance facility on the e-filing portal.
